title: Kairos: A Dataset for Fine-Grained Video-Language Modeling over Space, Time, and Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.08755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many emerging video language modeling tasks require systems to move beyond clip-level abstraction and model visual content as it unfolds over extended time horizons. However, most existing video datasets rely on coarse or sparsely aligned supervision, which compresses temporal variation and limits the ability of models to learn reusable representations of continuous visual dynamics. We introduce Kairos, a video dataset for video-language modeling with time-resolved annotations. Kairos consists of long-duration videos, ranging from ten minutes to half an hour, annotated with fine-grained temporal alignment. The annotations capture ongoing actions, entity appearances and attributes, interactions, and evolving contextual cues along the video timeline. This time-resolved structure supports fine-grained evaluation, long-range modeling and reasoning, instruction data construction, representation learning, and video generation. Kairos provide

translated_title: Kairos：一个面向空间、时间与动态的细粒度视频-语言建模数据集
translated_abstract: 许多新兴的视频语言建模任务要求系统能够超越片段级的抽象，对在长时间范围内逐步展开的视觉内容进行建模。然而，大多数现有的视频数据集依赖于粗粒度或稀疏对齐的监督信号，这压缩了时间上的变化，限制了模型学习连续视觉动态可复用表示的能力。我们提出了Kairos，一个带有时间分辨标注的视频语言建模数据集。Kairos由长时视频组成，时长从十分钟到半小时不等，并配有细粒度的时间对齐标注。这些标注沿视频时间轴捕捉了持续进行的动作、实体的出现及其属性、交互以及不断演变的上下文线索。这种时间分辨的结构支持细粒度评估、长程建模与推理、指令数据构建、表示学习以及视频生成等任务。
tldr: Kairos是一个带有细粒度时间对齐标注的长时视频数据集，能够支持细粒度视频-语言建模、长程推理、指令数据构建与视频生成等多种任务。
en_tdlr: Kairos is a long-duration video dataset with fine-grained time-resolved annotations that enables fine-grained video-language modeling, long-range reasoning, instruction data construction, and video generation.
